about: The budgets of `bun run labs verify --perf`: rows of `labs bench --quick` on Chromium, one set per backend. WebGPU is the default backend of the labs. Only rows that were stable over 3 quick runs on the dev Mac have a budget (Apple M5 Pro; WebGL 2026-10-13, both backends again 2026-10-14 at load 1.7-2.1; spread under 10 %). A budget is the worst of the 3 runs with a margin, or the performance target where it holds. The start steps, the CPU shares and the capture rows have no budget yet.

frame.afterSeek.basis: 16.1-33.1 ms: one worker frame and one paint, so 16 or 33 ms by the time of the paint relative to the vsync; the performance target is 30 ms

scrub.rate.basis: 60 Hz in 3 runs; the performance target is 60 Hz

strip.idb16.basis: 23-29 ms (2026-10-14): the first real read from IndexedDB, 16 read-write transactions (stripCache.ts); the performance target of 20 ms needs one batched read

heap.page.basis: 88-89 MB (2026-10-14; 49 MB on 2026-10-13): the dev-server modules of the larger pose model (59 → 126 modules) and of the new lab parts; a fresh page holds 65 MB

start.httpWarm.frameReady.basis: 933-949 ms; the performance limit of the first warm frame

start.httpCold.firstFrame.basis: 432-434 ms: WebGPU needs 70-80 ms more than WebGL to start its renderer

frame.afterSeek.basis: 32.6-33 ms: one worker frame and one paint; the performance target is 30 ms

scrub.rate.basis: 59 Hz in 3 runs; the performance target is 60 Hz

start.httpWarm.frameReady.basis: 1,050-1,063 ms; the performance limit of the first warm frame
